review: Reviewed the complete character, both hands, matched legs, side/back views and the repaired desktop/mobile studio. Close-up controls now stay clear of the slippers. All 46 checks pass, including actual posed segment lengths, sole heights, connected hand topology, touch and keyboard controls, offline rendering and GLB reload. The 95/100 score is a subjective visual review, not an image-similarity measurement or an AAA certification.
testsSummary: 46 checks passed · equal leg segments · closed hand meshes

iterations.title: First full-volume assembly
iterations.note: All principal features are present. Review found muted lighting, scalp clipping, a wrist seam, and overly small sleeve prints.

iterations.title: Color, fabric and all-angle review
iterations.note: Brightened the palette, enlarged cat prints and closed the wrist and shorts intersections. Portrait and rear views exposed oversized eye contours and a heavy back-hair core.

iterations.title: A cleaner face and rear silhouette
iterations.note: Opened the hair part, reduced the eye outlines, unified neck topology and replaced the protruding back-hair core with continuous layered strands.

iterations.title: Expression, proportions and pillow volume
iterations.note: Corrected iris aspect ratio and chin projection, softened the expression, and replaced the rigid pillow outline with curved sewn edges. Checked the front, portrait and three-quarter views.

iterations.title: Soft cotton, rounded cuffs and a settled pose
iterations.note: Replaced pointed waves with rounded cloth scallops, added pillow tension folds, varied the cat print, exposed the slipper bows and introduced a subtle upper-body lean.

iterations.title: A quieter expression and cleaner fabric layers
iterations.note: Enlarged the irises, softened the chin, narrowed the brows, added the white inner facing, and restored a visible tapered tip to the swept bang.

iterations.title: A useful comparison, not a finished fringe
iterations.note: The cooler violet palette, grey halo and rear-foot step improved the study. The narrower central forelock exposed too much left brow and weakened the likeness; the next edit replaces its tube-like profile.

iterations.title: A sculpted ribbon rather than a hair tube
iterations.note: Rebuilt the main fringe with independently authored silhouette edges and real thickness. Reduced the upper-lid contour and gave the eyes a slight sideways gaze.

iterations.title: Recovered curl study
iterations.note: Recovered and inspected the saved portrait and three-quarter views. All key features exist; the fringe-root opening, eye scale, and cloth stiffness still need refinement.

iterations.title: Softer face, cleaner strand shading
iterations.note: Smoothed duplicate-position normals and removed noisy hair self-shadows. The review exposed an unwanted crown sliver and excessively tall irises; the visual score is unchanged.

iterations.title: Profile check and crown experiment
iterations.note: The independent halo tilt and softer eye contours are useful, but the added crown volume reads like a cap. The side review also exposed an unnatural bend above the far slipper.

iterations.title: A useful rejected arm contour
iterations.note: The far leg is smoother and the crown cap is gone, but the hand-authored forearm edges were not perpendicular to its direction, making it unnaturally narrow. This pass is not accepted as an improvement.

iterations.title: Curved hair volumes and a full forearm
iterations.note: The beveled curl is more organic and the forearm has its intended volume. Layer-isolation renders found older strands and outline shells intersecting the new fringe; these are the next cleanup target.

iterations.title: A clean, curved forehead curl
iterations.note: Removed intersecting fringe layers and replaced unstable outline shells with fine contours. The portrait and three-quarter views now show a clean open curl and a full, continuous raised forearm. Clothing still looks too stiff.

iterations.title: Looser cotton and a curved collar
iterations.note: Lengthened the shirt, added shallow fabric folds, curved the lapels, and matched the pocket print to the shirt. Front and rear reviews show continuous geometry; the pillow still hangs too far away from the legs.

iterations.title: A pillow that settles behind the pose
iterations.note: Broadened and turned the filled pillow behind the legs, added a subtle crown highlight, and strengthened the relaxed head tilt. Front, portrait and side renders show a more coherent silhouette; proportions are still being compared visually.

iterations.title: Balanced head and accessory proportions
iterations.note: The head and slippers are closer to the reference proportions. The full-body review found that the shirt hem and held pillow moved upward too much; their offsets will be reduced.

iterations.title: Settled proportions and a cleaner silhouette
iterations.note: Reduced the lower-torso offset so the shirt and held pillow settle closer to the reference. The head, shoulder and shorts proportions are now more coherent. Reviewed renders have no invalid coordinates or JavaScript errors.

iterations.title: The same sculpture, fewer draw calls
iterations.note: Preserved the named editable sculpture and its 282,572 triangles while batching the draw tree into 30 meshes. The tested front view dropped from 276 to 33 draw calls. GLB export and reload preserve all 194 named parts.

iterations.title: Mobile and offline studio validation
iterations.note: All 26 automated checks passed, including mobile layout and offline HTML startup. A separate visual review still found the near slipper partly behind the mobile toolbar, so a stricter framing regression check was added for the next pass.

iterations.title: Validated desktop, mobile, and offline checkpoint
iterations.note: Completed the front, portrait, side and rear review. The mobile title no longer covers the face, both slippers remain above the toolbar, and all 28 automated checks pass. The character remains a static 85/100 subjective likeness study, below the requested 95/100 target.

iterations.title: Equal-length legs in Colab
iterations.note: Both legs now share thigh and shin lengths, with grounded slippers. Front and side review confirms the missing right lower-leg length is restored; the near thigh needs additional clearance inside the scalloped cuff.

iterations.title: Continuous palm and finger sculpture
iterations.note: Replaced disconnected palm and finger tubes with two blended full-volume hand meshes. Cuff clearance is restored. Close-up review found the pillow hand rotated inward and temple fingers occluded by the headband; those contact issues are the next correction.

iterations.title: Anatomical lengths and correctly oriented hands
iterations.note: Both legs share 1.40-unit thighs and 1.632-unit shins, and both feet are grounded. The hands now face correctly and the temple fingers clear the headband. Close-up review still shows a fused ring-finger contact and an overly rounded wrist transition.

iterations.title: Smoother wrists and clean hand topology
iterations.note: Angled wrist pads now follow the forearms. Both hand skins have zero boundary edges, nonmanifold edges, or repeated-index triangles. The raised ring finger still needs more clearance from its neighbor; the next pass moves it backward rather than fusing it to another digit.

iterations.title: Matched legs and multi-angle hand review
iterations.note: Front and oblique hand views confirm separate digits and a more natural grip. Both feet now sit on the same ground plane. The leg close-up revealed that the near scalloped cuff needs the same depth offset as its pant leg; this is corrected in the next pass.

iterations.title: Relaxed gesture and matching cuff clearance
iterations.note: Straightened the middle finger, concealed the wrist overlaps, and matched the near cuff depth to its pant leg. The close-up caught an overlarge separate pillow flap; the next pass replaces it with a pinched corner of the pillow surface itself.

iterations.title: Connected cloth rather than a separate flap
iterations.note: The pillow pinch is now part of the pillow surface. Review found the cloth obscuring too much of the gripping hand and the front fabric too bright; the next pass adjusts contact depth and restores fold shading.

iterations.title: Visible fingers and better cloth contact
iterations.note: Moved the gripping hand forward and restored readable fabric shading. Fingers are visible again, but the macro view still reveals a separate wrist surface. The next pass replaces each arm and hand with one connected sculpt.

iterations.title: Continuous wrists need finer local sampling
iterations.note: Unified each arm and hand into one sculpt, but the close-up exposed coarse finger shading and an outline artifact. The topology audit also caught a clipped shoulder boundary. The next pass concentrates samples on the hands, expands the shoulder bounds, and reduces the hand outline thickness.

iterations.title: Seamless wrists with concentrated hand detail
iterations.note: Adaptive sampling improves the wrist transition and fingers. The audit localized a small opening to the hidden shoulder sampling boundary, not the hand. The next edit expands that boundary, gives the fingers more samples in every axis, and restores crisp arm contours without thick finger outlines.

iterations.title: One continuous surface from arm to fingertips
iterations.note: Both arms now flow into the wrists, palms and fingers without separate wrist pieces. The corrected anatomy audit reports zero open or nonmanifold edges on both arm-hand surfaces. Tapered ink keeps the arm silhouette clear while avoiding thick outlines between the fingers.

iterations.title: Soft slipper seams and ribbon-shaped bows
iterations.note: Replaced the pearl-like trim with a gathered seam and modeled ribbon loops. Close-up review found a gap between the rounded sole and trim, so the next pass rebuilds the sole as a filled padded volume and removes the overly square bow tails.

iterations.title: More natural hair flow and connected footwear
iterations.note: Varied the rear hair lengths and drift, replacing broad repeated stripes with narrow surface-following highlights. The padded slipper soles are now connected, and both arm-hand surfaces remain closed after smoothing. Next: fabric thickness, shoulder coverage, and the headband.

iterations.title: Cloth thickness and a more natural headband
iterations.note: Closed the cuff surfaces with thin fabric walls, improved the raised sleeve coverage, slimmed the slipper soles, and replaced the foam-like headband with a gathered cloth band. The build now receives a Chrome startup check before publication.

iterations.title: Softer expression and warmer skin tone
iterations.note: Opened the eyes slightly, refined the violet iris paint, softened the blush marks, and adjusted the head tilt. The staged build passes Chrome startup before publication. The next pass reduces dense arm geometry while preserving the reviewed silhouette and hand shapes.

iterations.title: Recovered leaner arm geometry
iterations.note: The recovered front, hand and side renders preserve the longer right leg and continuous wrists. The current audit catches one nonmanifold edge in the simplified gripping hand; this pass is not accepted as topology-complete. Next: widen finger clearances and validate the actual posed joints.

iterations.title: Separated gripping fingers and shaped knees
iterations.note: Refined the thumb, separated the four curled fingers, and added subtle kneecap, shin and ankle forms without changing leg segment lengths. The remaining topology defect was traced to an opposite duplicate triangle pair on the wrist rather than fused digits.

iterations.title: Matched leg anatomy and clean continuous hands
iterations.note: Visually reviewed the legs and both hands from front and oblique angles. Both arm-hand meshes now have zero open or nonmanifold edges; the opposite duplicate wrist flap was removed. Thighs and shins retain equal left/right lengths, with shaped knees, calves and grounded ankles.

iterations.title: Restored face proportions and fitted headband
iterations.note: Restored vertical face length and improved the cloth headband fit. Front and side views remain coherent. The separate neck-facing strip and detached-looking temple lock still need cleanup.

iterations.title: Continuous hair layers and a cleaner expression
iterations.note: Replaced the isolated temple tube with a root-to-tip curved ribbon, added fine strand flow, softened the eye proportions, and removed the floating neck-facing strip. Portrait and side review show a cleaner hairline, neckline and headband fit.

iterations.title: Sewn cotton details and clean cuff edges
iterations.note: Added a fine pocket seam, stronger controlled fabric drape, and clean white cuff piping. Removed the rectangular neck shadow. The close-up now shows readable cotton folds and a pocket that follows the shirt surface.

iterations.title: Consistent cotton print across the garment
iterations.note: Replaced height-dependent texture distortion with consistent physical-scale fabric coordinates and aligned the breast-pocket print to the shirt. Front, garment close-up and rear reviews show a coherent cotton pattern. The stronger global cel-lighting experiment was not adopted because it dulled the pale blue and white fabrics.

iterations.title: Readable knees, fingers and warm skin shading
iterations.note: Adopted restrained tonal steps only on the skin, leaving the blue pajamas and white pillow luminous. The updated knee and ankle shapes are easier to read, and close-up review confirms clean wrist and finger contours. The temple gesture still sits slightly low relative to the reference, so its placement is refined next.

iterations.title: A higher temple gesture and inspectable leg joints
iterations.note: Raised the right-hand gesture toward the headband while preserving continuous arm and hand geometry. The leg correction is now inspectable through measured posed landmarks and an optional joint guide, not a hardcoded size label. Both hands remain closed manifold surfaces.

iterations.title: Filled pillow folds and softer outer hair
iterations.note: Refined the pillow shading and sewn edge so its filled volume and tension folds read from three-quarter view. Added fine tapered flyaways to soften the main hair mass. The right hand still hovers slightly away from the temple in the oblique view, so its contact placement is adjusted next.

iterations.title: Natural temple contact and keyboard control
iterations.note: Moved the raised hand inward and back so the gesture meets the temple in the three-quarter view rather than hovering away from the head. Refined detail-camera framing and added keyboard orbit, zoom and reset. Hand topology and bilateral leg dimensions remain unchanged in quality.

iterations.title: Detailed fingers and measured ground contact
iterations.note: Added subtle palmar joint creases and measured the actual slipper sole surfaces. All 42 expanded browser, anatomy, touch, keyboard, offline and GLB checks passed. Desktop and mobile screenshots exposed missing font glyphs in the controls; those are corrected before the checkpoint is packaged.

iterations.title: Font-independent studio controls
iterations.note: Replaced missing control glyphs with embedded vector icons and passed 43 checks. Visual mobile review found that detail selection could leave the model above the screen, and the measurement note inherited a large heading font. Navigation and note sizing are corrected next.

iterations.title: Clear mobile navigation and measured anatomy panel
iterations.note: All 45 checks passed and the main mobile view now shows the complete character with working vector controls. Detail buttons return to the model, and measurement text is compact. The enlarged leg-guide review revealed that its camera controls still covered part of the slippers, so close-up viewports receive their own reserved control area.

iterations.title: Reviewed Colab character and anatomy checkpoint
iterations.note: Reviewed the complete character, both hands, matched legs, side/back views and the repaired desktop/mobile studio. Close-up controls now stay clear of the slippers. All 46 checks pass, including actual posed segment lengths, sole heights, connected hand topology, touch and keyboard controls, offline rendering and GLB reload. The 95/100 score is a subjective visual review, not an image-similarity measurement or an AAA certification.
